title: ICT-gebruik op scholen - ICTS 2001
authors: Haan, J. de, Huysmans, F., Sociaal en Cultureel Planbureau  (primary investigator)
contributors: RU Utrecht, Fac. Sociale Wetenschappen (research initiator)
RU Utrecht, Fac. Sociale Wetenschappen (data collector)
descriptions: Survey concerning computer skills of secondary school pupils. The schools concerned are pre-vocational secondary schools (VMBO) grade 3, senior general secondary schools (HAVO)grades 3 and 4, and pre-university schools (VWO) grades 3, 4 and 5. Results from a survey among ICT coordinators were added to the dataset.
